Sub: Revised rate of interest - with regard to Staff Provident Fund in

Sir,

Please refer to the Resolution dated 19 march, 2012 issued by Ministry
of Finance (Department of Economic Affairs) regarding revision of rate of
interest of General Provident Fund (GPF) and other similar funds.

2. In this connection, it is announced for general information that during the
year 2011-2012, accumulations at the credit of subscribers to the Staff
Provident Fund shall carry interest of rate of 8% (Eight per cent) for the period
from 01.04.2011 to 30.11.2011 and 8.6% (Eight point six percent) w.e.f.

01.12.2011.

New Delhi, the 19° March, 2012

RESOLUTION

It is announced for general information that during the year 2011-2012, accumulations at the credit of subscribers to the General
Provident Fund and other similar funds shall carry interest at the rate of 8% (Eight per cent) for the period from 1.4.2011 to 30.11.2011
and 8.6% (eight point six percent) with effect from 1.12.2011. The funds concerned are:—
